abilities.name: Petricite Burst
abilities.text: After using an ability, gains a charge (max 3 charges). His next attack expands a charge to whirl his chains, causing the effects: Deals 81 ( 130% AD + 30% AP ) magic damage to the primary target; Deals 25 ( 40% AD + 20% AP ) magic damage to other nearby enemies; Gains 125% Attack Speed while he has at least 1 charge. Deals 100% damage to monsters. Executes minions below 25 Health when they are secondary targets. Only damage against the primary target can Critically Strike.

abilities.name: Chain Lash
abilities.text: Lashes his chains out, intersecting at the target location and casing the effects below: Deals 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 ( +40% AP ) magic damage ; Slows by 15% / 20% / 25% / 30% for 1.5 seconds; After 0.6 seconds, the place where the chains intersect explode with magical energy, dealing a further 80 / 140 / 200 / 260 ( +80% AP ) magic damage . The explosion deals 30% damage to minions.

abilities.name: Kingslayer
abilities.text: Lunges at an enemy with magical force, dealing 75 / 125 / 175 / 225 ( +60% AP ) magic damage . If the target is a champion, Sylas restores 30 / 60 / 90 / 120 ( +30% AP +5% bonus HP ) Health . For every 1% of own max HP missing, the healing is increased by 1.67% , up to 60 / 120 / 180 / 240 ( +60% AP +10% bonus HP ) Health .

abilities.name: Abscond / Abduct
abilities.text: First Cast : Dashes a short distance. Recast : Throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing 80 / 150 / 220 / 290 ( +80% AP ) magic damage and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. On arrival, he knocks up the target for 0.5 seconds.

abilities.name: Hijack
abilities.text: Throws his chains at the target. If they hit a champion, he hijacks them, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate ability. The stolen ability retains its original effects and matches Sylas' ultimate ability level. Hijacking an enemy places a cooldown o them for 200% (modified by Sylas' ability cooldown) of the enemy's ultimate ability's cooldown, with a minimum of 40 seconds, during which Sylas cannot hijack them again. Sylas converts Attack Damage bonuses from the stolen ultimate into Ability Power: Every 1% bonus Attack Damage is converted into 0.4% bonus Ability Power ; Every 1% total Attack Damage is converted into 0.6% bonus Ability Power .
